lead_sources: Domain found by checking likely names in the Wayback CDX index; no news or official page named it. The archived site itself is the only source.
page_evidence: About - Weiers for Mayor: "Jerry Weiers has represented the West Valley in the State Legislature for nearly eight years ... who better to now help with Glendale through its many storm clouds than a pilot?" Footer: "Paid by Weiers for Mayor"
note: 70 HTTP 200 captures (all file types) from 2011-11-06 to 2012-11-06; the first is 2012-04-28 and the last is 2012-11-02. I read the 2012-06-29 about page and the 2012-04-28 home page (title Weiers for Mayor, nav Home/About/Issues/News/Volunteer/Donate/Contact). The CDX was queried by host with matchType=host, so the count includes css, robots.txt and other files, not only HTML pages. The given election date is 2012-11-06, but Wikipedia lists the mayoral election as 2012-08-28; the window follows the given date and the page is in both windows.

Searched the web, Wikipedia, KJZZ, newpolitics.org and Phoenix New Times: no 2012 mayoral website named. cruzforarizona.com is archived in 2010 only (earlier Cruz race, no 2012 mayoral check; not accepted). Guessed domains cruzformayor.com, mannycruzformayor.com, manny4mayor.com, cruz4glendale.com, cruzforglendale.com, mannycruz2012.com, mannyformayor.com: the CDX query for them failed with connection refused, so they are unchecked. Ballotpedia blocked access.

Searched the web, ABC15, Joyce Clark Unfiltered, KJZZ and Wikipedia: none names a campaign website. Checked mark4mayor.com: 2016 captures show a HugeDomains sale page, not Burdick. burdickformayor.com, markburdick.com, votemarkburdick.com and markburdickformayor.com have no CDX captures. Other guessed domains (burdick4glendale.com, burdickforglendale.com, mark4glendale.com, markburdick.org) were unchecked because Wayback refused connections. Ballotpedia blocked access.

Searched the web, KTAR, Rose Law Group, Arizona Daily Independent and BallotReady: articles say she had a campaign website but give no domain. Checked domains: robertson4mayor.com has captures from 2024 only; votemichellerobertson.com has 2018 captures only and none in the 2020 window (likely a different campaign); michellerobertson.com has 2004 captures. michelleforglendale.com, michelle4glendale.com, robertsonformayor.com and electmichellerobertson.com have no CDX captures. Other guesses were unchecked because Wayback refused connections. Ballotpedia blocked access.
